statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
CPT code 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The patient has diagnosis code I47.1
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
